name: Kōryō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōryō town emblem in green: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Kōryō, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kōryō town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top
